source_title: Game Theory #15: The Return of History
summary: This March 24, 2026 lecture records Jiang's end-of-history reversal: the Iran-war context marks the end of the unipolar Pax Americana order, shifting the lens from efficiency, cheap energy, dollar enchantment, and science-priesthood toward resilience, scarcity, spiritual/national remobilization, techno-martial administration, and constant political flux.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: techno-martialism gives freedom at the top and slaves or serfs at the bottom under AI scarcity administration.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Mass Society page already carries this source as the durable anchor for AI surveillance plus scarcity allocation becoming a martial population-control form.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: the nation-state system may break into more resilient communities, perhaps city-states, under constant flux.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Nation page already uses this source for the successor-body question: when old national categories stop holding, smaller political communities may become the resilient form.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as a dated forecast-family hinge for the return-of-history sequence: the Iran-war context ends the unipolar moment, Pax Judaica becomes an Israel-local-hegemon forecast, Germany/Russia may fight before realigning, Japan may transfer power voluntarily from old to young, America may become an American Holy Empire, and East Asian coalitions remain in flux.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns the dated claims, horizons, and later comparison. Eschatology owns holy empire and Pax Judaica only where sacred role-script is the active mechanism; Nation owns successor political body; Strategy/Chokepoint own material war feasibility.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the efficiency-to-resilience sequence as material-test support: cheap petroleum, GCC-China oil circulation, cheap flights, undersea cables, fertilizer, food, and water expose the post-unipolar world as a survival audit rather than a story about restoring normalcy after one war.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The war/material-test page owns whether the system survives energy, food, water, shipping, cable, and logistics shocks. Mass Society owns the administrative form after scarcity becomes population control.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the dollar pillar as supporting evidence for money's collective enchantment and generational psychology: the dollar works because paper is treated as gold, then decays through printing, inequality, gambling, and the conclusion that labor cannot catch the old order.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns the symbol-to-reality conversion and monetary spell. Gerontocracy owns old-age possession of assets and rule; Attention or Dead World should receive gambling/lying-flat only when the active mechanism is attention capture or materialist despair.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Record the science-priesthood passage as boundary pressure between Religion As Administrative Filter and Reason As Replacement Religion: science becomes a global religion and transnational priesthood under Pax Americana, then hardens from innovation into orthodoxy and suppression.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Administrative Filter owns trusted operator/priesthood selection. The atlas-level Reason As Replacement Religion owns secular truth-making and salvation work; Bureaucracy owns scientific procedure when doubt is institutionally organized rather than suppressed.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the aging-power passage as a regime-transfer recurrence: baby boomers live longer, keep money, health care, voting power, and political control, preventing the young from gaining ruling experience until war or voluntary national obligation forces transfer.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Gerontocracy owns the age-class blockage and sacrifice/transfer problem. Prediction owns Japan-specific and war-transfer forecasts; Nation owns the national body that can make older people accept obligation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the definition support for techno-martialism, where AI surveillance and resource scarcity split freedom at the top from bonded administration at the bottom.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: No immediate append is needed after PR #891. Mass Society is at the source-density review band; any further use of this source should replace or route prose rather than expand the page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as support for city-state-after-nation-state, where constant flux makes fixed enemy maps obsolete and smaller resilient communities become plausible successor bodies.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns the successor political body. Civilization may own city-state as a whole form of life; Mass Society owns scale failure and population management.

new_lens_seeds.title: Resilience After Efficiency
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A civilization trained to optimize for best-case cheapness, speed, profit, and abundance becomes fragile when energy, food, water, trade, and political trust are stressed; resilience begins by imagining worst-case survival rather than maximum efficiency.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The efficiency/resilience distinction travels across Jiang's war, food, oil, megacity, migration, freedom, spiritual-revival, and community-scale diagnoses. It may remain distributed across Strategy, Chokepoint, Mass Society, Nation, and Human Heart, but the March 24 source gives it a named, reusable operating test.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create a standalone Resilience page from this source alone. First compare with existing Chokepoint/Hormuz, Mass Society scarcity, Human Heart crisis-survival, and Nation city-state/community evidence.

new_lens_seeds.title: Return Of History After Pax Americana
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A world order that declares history finished can hide coercion, expertise, dollar desire, cheap energy, and population growth until a war exposes the order as temporary and forces history back as scarcity, migration, blocs, religious remobilization, and shifting alliances.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source gathers many existing mechanisms into one chronological hinge: end-of-history ideology, Pax Americana machinery, science-priesthood, dollar spell, Iran as trigger, and post-unipolar flux. It is likely a concept-cluster proposal rather than a public page until adjacent no-successor and multipolar-order sources are compared.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create standalone End Of History, Pax Americana, Fukuyama, Science Priesthood, American Holy Empire, Pax Judaica, Techno-Martialism, or Constant Flux pages from this source alone.

chronology_notes.note: On 2026-03-24 Jiang dates the end of the post-Cold-War unipolar moment to the Iran-war context, framing Fukuyama's end of history as the ideology of a temporary American order rather than an enduring human endpoint.

This source supplies a March 2026 Pax Americana mechanism stack: aerial supremacy and CIA/special-forces sorting, internet mood surveillance, rules-based-order disguise, science as global priesthood, and the U.S. dollar as shared enchantment.

The lecture turns the post-unipolar forecast into a survival chronology: efficiency gives way to resilience, cheap petroleum and global trade become fragile, megacities become anti-resilient, and food/water/resource stress turns into migration, blocs, slavery/serfdom risk, and techno-martial administration.

The source is a forecast-family input, not a ledger promotion: Pax Judaica, Germany/Russia, Japan's voluntary youth transfer, American Holy Empire, China containment, Japan rise, and city-state fragmentation should be compared with later and earlier dated sources before canon or ledger work.

next_actions.action: No immediate Mass Society or Nation prose mutation is needed: both public pages already cite this source and preserve durable lens points for techno-martialism and city-state-after-nation-state.

Before any public Resilience After Efficiency page, write a concept-cluster proposal comparing this source with Hormuz/chokepoint, food-water-scarcity, Human Heart crisis-survival, Mass Society techno-martialism, and Nation/city-state evidence.

A later Prediction review should split this lecture's forecast pressure into dated families rather than one broad return-of-history entry: Pax Judaica, Germany/Russia, Japan youth transfer, American Holy Empire, East Asia coalition flux, and city-state fragmentation.

If public Power, Religion, or Gerontocracy work uses this source, keep the active mechanism narrow: dollar enchantment and gambling psychology to Power, science-priesthood and orthodoxy to Religion/Reason-as-replacement, and age-class rule-transfer to Gerontocracy.
